paraphrase: Buddhaghosa, a brahmin from near the Bodhi tree, was converted by the elder Revata, came to Lanka in the reign of Mahānāma, wrote the Visuddhimagga as a test, and was then given the Sinhala commentaries to render into Pali.
translation_basis: paraphrase made by the unit author from the Pali where the passage was read locally; otherwise from the author's knowledge of the text
